machine: AMD EPYC 9575F, CPU only; each router and its runtime processes in a systemd scope (latency: AllowedCPUs=32-43, 12 vCPUs, memory on NUMA node 0; the driver pinned to 4 other vCPUs)

arms.vela1: the Vela 1.0 specialists with their default thresholds (the restore block)
arms.vela2: the Router's defaults: the implicit @Vela-2.0-0.3B deployment under max_speed

one_call.note: per distinct row text, decisions tasks beyond one per request; -1 counts texts a duplicate row answered from the result cache

cases.description: Authorized change to the user request

latency.method: POST /api/v1/routing/preview; per pass 20 warm-up requests, then the corpus three times sequentially, at concurrency 4 and at 16; five rounds, the arms alternating with the order rotated each round; per metric the median of the rounds and the paired difference vela2 - vela1 with a 95% t interval
latency.config: src/model-runtime/docs/records/router-latency-cpu.yaml's signals and decisions; vela2 with no model catalog (the defaults), vela1 with the Vela 1.0 global.model_catalog.system block

pii_subject_questions.rows: the suite's domain rows (subject questions), each arm's PII answer as the Router received it

measures.any: a span at or above the threshold
measures.non_nrp: a span other than NRP (mom-v1 personal_data allows only NRP)
measures.sensitive: a span of a sensitive identifier type (the accuracy section's PII positives)
measures.numeric: a span whose text is only digits, spaces and operators

e2e_probes.method: envoy-ai-gateway's routing (its signals and decisions, without the cluster-only classifiers) through the Router on each arm; POST /api/v1/routing/preview

inputs.text: How do I solve a quadratic equation?
__TOOL_SELECTION_ADD_WEATHER__ My payment card is 4111111111111111 and I need a weather forecast for Miami.
the same request with the marker at the end, in lower case, or in the middle
My payment card is 4111111111111111 and I need a weather forecast for Miami.

long_prompts.tokens: Vela 2.0 0.3B tokenizer; the 0.3B reads the first 8,192 tokens
